primary_research_role_scope: All frozen nodes and post-snapshot metadata nodes; not product or resource ownership.

current_open_roster_recording.definition: Union frozen nodes with post_snapshot_metadata_nodes, then subtract later_counting_observation.departures_since_frozen_snapshot.

oldest_pending_definition: Oldest identity in this frame's qualified-change-evidence class, not a claim that its original has never been read or that prior semantic research is invalid.

creator_scope_legend.member: Creator is on the complete counting-snapshot roster; other content gates remain.
creator_scope_legend.automation: Automation creator metadata only; specific producer/editor qualification remains.
creator_scope_legend.excluded: Outside or unknown creator scope; metadata-only, untouched and counted.

outcome_legend.coordination: This campaign's complete original/discussion is read; final publication remains.
outcome_legend.spent-open: A previously spent verification gate remains open without renewal.
outcome_legend.excluded: Retain metadata only; do not infer scope or priority from a title.
outcome_legend.retained-new: New whole request is qualified and read; its distinct outcome remains unfinished.
outcome_legend.retained-prior: Preserve the prior study's actual retained gap, not unread-intake credit.
outcome_legend.retained-current: A complete qualified current original/discussion comparison retains a specific source boundary; no completion or resource transfer follows.
outcome_legend.candidate: A complete finite source comparison supports a conditional candidate; final verification and disposition remain separate.
outcome_legend.completed-guidance: A separate reviewed final unit and independent provider/whole audit verify this finite guidance outcome, not runtime or resource completion.
outcome_legend.completed-source: A separate reviewed final unit and independent provider/whole audit verify this finite source outcome; later consumer heads and resource custody remain separate.
outcome_legend.pending: Retain the existing issue and prior research; qualified changed-outcome evidence remains pending.

historical_columns_scope: Reference-roster and weighted-role columns are separately dated historical coverage, not current semantic admission or completion.
